sources.title: 海淀区城市更新实施指引（2025年版）
sources.publisher: 北京市海淀区人民政府
sources.usage: Implementation framework reference for JZ project approval pathways: joint review process, multi-plan integration, planning permission, construction permits. Used to ground JZ-01 through JZ-06 implementation cards in actual Beijing/Haidian regulatory processes.

sources.title: 关于优化本市城市更新项目审批服务推动并联办理的工作方案（试行）
sources.publisher: 北京市住房和城乡建设委员会等5部门
sources.usage: Beijing municipal urban renewal approval streamlining: parallel processing, multi-plan integration platform, tiered planning/building permit procedures. Supports JZ project approval pathway design.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国个人信息保护法
sources.publisher: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会
sources.usage: Legal framework for data minimization (Art.6), retention limits (Art.19), sensitive information processing (Art.28-30), deletion rights (Art.47), and appeal mechanisms (Art.50). Referenced in privacy implementation table and AI scenario governance.

sources.title: 网络数据安全管理条例
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国国务院
sources.usage: Network data security management: personal information processing rules, consent requirements, automated collection deletion (Art.24), complaint channels (Art.20).

sources.title: 无障碍设计规范 (GB 50763-2012)
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
sources.usage: National standard for accessibility design in the built environment. Referenced for inclusive design: barrier-free ramps, tactile indicators, accessible toilets, signage, and evacuation.

sources.title: 建筑与市政工程无障碍通用规范 (GB 55019-2021)
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
sources.usage: Mandatory national standard for accessibility in buildings and municipal infrastructure. Full compliance required for all new/renovated public buildings.

sources.title: 城市公共设施适老化设施服务要求与评价 (GB/T 45158-2024)
sources.publisher: 国家市场监督管理总局、国家标准化管理委员会
sources.usage: Recommended national standard for age-friendly urban public facilities: emergency call devices, anti-slip surfaces, resting areas, signage legibility. Referenced for elderly-inclusive design.

sources.title: 住房城乡建设部办公厅关于进一步加强城市无障碍设施建设工作的通知 (建办城〔2025〕7号)
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
sources.usage: Ministry notice reinforcing accessibility construction standards: five-synchronization principle, accessibility design monograph requirements, special inspection for barrier-free facilities.

sources.title: “三区两翼”打造世界级AI集聚地
sources.publisher: 北京市科学技术委员会、中关村科技园区管理委员会
sources.usage: Background context: three areas and two wings industrial spatial framework, AI innovation belt narrative. Used for industrial ecosystem context in coordinated research scope analysis.
